subject.title: fix(ci): bound plugin-npm-release git fetch and npm publish with timeout

question: Is a 120-second deadline with a 10-second termination grace period acceptable for legitimate `plugin-npm-release` fetches and npm publishes under the repository's release-operating expectations?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent with merged workflow precedent, but selecting the allowed maximum latency for a production plugin publish is an operational release-policy choice.

options.title: Accept the bounded deadline
options.body: Approve the 120-second plus 10-second grace budget, then refresh the merge result and required checks before landing.

options.title: Use a different release budget
options.body: Ask for a revised timeout if legitimate plugin registry or Git operations need more than two minutes under expected release conditions.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded deadline
recommendation.body: Approve the 120-second plus 10-second grace budget, then refresh the merge result and required checks before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged repository precedent for this bounded Git transport pattern.
